purpose: Pose library for the art factory v6 (owner feedback 2026-11-28: anatomy, continuous twist, more rear emphasis, variety, hotter). Each pose has a joint-by-joint text tuned against the observed failures (defects_1..3.json, BAKEOFF_VERDICT.md). Assembled into prompts by tools/art/recipe_v6.py.
yaw_convention: yaw_deg is the rotation of the body part away from the camera: 0 = facing the camera, 90 = exact profile, 180 = back to the camera. A twist is physically continuous when pelvis >= shoulders >= head for a look-back (the head turns last).
camera_rule: Always hip height or higher, portrait lens (long focal length), no wide-angle distortion, never from below the hem or the lap; raised knees and leg extensions run ALONG the image plane (profile), never toward the lens.

categories.rear_hip: standing, rear of the hips in view, over-the-shoulder / hip pop
categories.rear_lean: leaning forward on a table / rail / counter / wall / chair seen from behind-side
categories.rear_walk: walking away or pivoting with a glance back
categories.leg_focus_seated: seated poses where the legs are the subject (profile crossing, side-sit, perched)
categories.leg_focus_standing: standing poses where the legs are the subject (stride, lifted leg, wall, thigh band)
categories.bust_focus: waist-up or three-quarter figure with the bust-line as the subject
categories.lying: lying on the side / back / prone, legs run across the frame
categories.kneeling: upright, supported and half kneels (never all-fours)
categories.dynamic: canon base / win poses and action poses (twirl, lunge, leap, dance, straddle, squat)
categories.portrait_tease: bust-up portraits, hips not in frame
